notes: AWQ (typically W4) packaging of reference-tiny-llm for GPU vLLM. gpu_memory_mib is a DECLARED scheduler envelope from ~4x weight compression vs FP16 for this small model plus KV headroom — NOT a measured VRAM footprint and NOT a throughput/quality claim (ADR-002, ADR-007). Launch: vllm serve <awq-checkpoint> --quantization awq --dtype float16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85. Requires an AWQ-format checkpoint (AutoAWQ or equivalent); the phase-1 safetensors pin is not AWQ by itself.
